400.description: Invalid URL request. Returned when the url query parameter is missing, empty, malformed, or uses an unsupported protocol.

get.description: Returns metadata extracted from the target URL.

200.description: Available when the handle is unused or already owned by the current session user.

unavailable.summary: Handle is already owned by another user

400.description: Invalid request. Returned when the handle is missing, empty, malformed, or reserved.

get.description: Checks whether the authenticated user can use a handle. The requested value is normalized to lowercase before validation. Empty values, invalid formats, and reserved handles are rejected with a validation error. When the session is missing the route returns 401. When the handle is already owned by the current user it is treated as available; when another user owns it the response is { available: false }.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: Handle to check. The server trims whitespace, lowercases the value, and applies the canonical handle validation rules before looking it up in the database.

200.description: Successful me response. `user` is always present. `currentPlan` and `profilePage` are nullable when the user has no plan or owned profile page.

404.description: No user-owned app context exists for the current session.

500.description: Internal me data is inconsistent. This usually means a required user, plan, or profile row is missing.

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's app bootstrap context. `user` is always present, `currentPlan` and `profilePage` can be null, and password data is never exposed.

200.description: Analytics summary response. `state` identifies whether analytics is ready, disabled, or the user has no owned profile page.

get.description: Returns the authenticated owner's analytics summary for the current profile page. The response is a stateful DTO with ready, no-profile, and disabled variants. The server normalizes timezone input, reads ownership from the authenticated session, and returns no-store headers on success.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: Profile handle from the URL path. The route forwards this value directly to the lookup layer.

200.description: Successful profile response. `layout` is always present for every bento item. `viewer.canEdit` is true only for the authenticated owner of the page.

404.description: No profile page exists for the requested handle.

500.description: Internal profile data is inconsistent. This usually means a required layout or subtype row is missing.

get.description: Returns a profile page and its bento blocks for the provided handle. This endpoint is read-only and does not require authentication. If a session is present, the `viewer` object reflects whether the current user can edit the page.
